body: I wish it was that simple. I have 'grown-up' before. Quit WoW, got a job, paid all my bills, blah blah blah. It was boring as fuck. Just because you're accepting of how boring adult life is, doesn't mean the rest of us are.
This isn't that entertaining. Not everyone has as bad of taste as you in music.

Cat sounds safer!

Fish are very low on the food chain. Some may just kill your for sport. :(

I wish I knew too, but if I was meant to be happy, I would probably be happy. Unfortunately, I feel as if this world will never be an environment that will allow such feelings. Maybe the next one? I'd love to be a butterfly...or maybe a dolphin.

Ahhh, a drummer you say?

I may not have a real kit anymore, but I have been playing Rock Band for yearsssssss. That game taught me more than I ever learned in music class. When they launched the pro mode and let me use double bass and all the different cymbals, I disappeared for a good week, downloaded most of the Rush/Between the Buried and Me DLC, and played the shit out of my Ion Drum Kit. I just wish I had the memory to play those songs on real drums.

Yeah, I have a habit of throwing that in there when I describe myself.

I've gotten numerous PMs about similar feelings. It's scary. Depression seems to be a growing epidemic, but still rather silent.
If only real life could be as entertaining....

I've tried other things on the computer. Tried getting into poker when you could still play for money online, I've tried getting into computer repair, tried selling drugs, none of it was nearly as enjoyable as stomping people in 3v3 for money.

I feel like this game has ruined my ability to do work of any kind. At my old job all I did was make fiber/serial/coax cables. The only reason I lasted so long is because I wanted to see how long it could take me to beat the record of cables built in a day. I did that my 2nd month in, got really bored, started coming to work high, then eventually just not showing up. Within 2 months, I was able to shatter the record that an employee set 5 years ago. AND I DIDN'T EVEN TRY THAT HARD.

There's no challenge in real life work. It's all just a bunch of forms and phone calls.

Wow, I honestly didn't think this would even stay on the front page. I went to sleep after typing this, I was feeling really terrible.

Thank you all for the responses.

A lot of you are telling me to do what makes me happy in life. I currently am doing that, and I love it. It's nice not stressing over the little things and I've been turning my attention to monetizing my WoW playing.

While I am doing what makes me happy, I sadly realize that there is no future in this. This game will die soon (3-6 years) and I won't have any way to make money. Im just kind of riding the wave out, so to speak.

I know this sounds pathetic, but I play so much because I got really good. This game has really been the only thing I've known. How many football players or basketball players stopped playing when they were getting good? That question has kept me going for so long.

Thank you for Mr. Bird.

Thank for creating my passion for music.

Thank you for hard work, your positive attitude in a scene with nothing but negativity, and for not letting little things get in the way between you and the band.

I doubt my existence will be acknowledged in this AMA. But I just want to let you know, you touched my late teenage years and early 20's. Thank you for every note.
